storage: Whole: cool, dry place. Grated: airtight box in the fridge for 1–2 days, or freeze in small portions for several weeks.
looksLike: A round, hard, brown, hairy-husked or de-husked shell about the size of a large fist, with water inside. The thick white flesh is grated into moist white shreds.
howToPick: Heavy for its size, with water that sloshes when shaken; no cracks, wet eyes or mould. A sour smell means it has turned.
shelfLife: Whole nut: 1–2 weeks at room temperature; grated: use in 1–2 days chilled (general guidance, not from a source in this run).
substitutes: Thick coconut milk, 60 ml in place of 40 g grated
Desiccated coconut, soaked in warm water

usedIn.raw: 40 g per serving (about ⅓ cup, loosely packed), ground into the masala; 25 g in the lower-oil version
